Class TileManager

java.lang.Object
tile.TileManager
public class TileManager extends Object
Manages the tile map: loading tile archetypes, reading the map layout from a text file, and rendering the visible portion of the map each frame.

Tile data

tiles holds the small set of unique tile archetypes (e.g. dirt, grass). mapTilesNum is an 80 × 60 grid of indices into that array, one entry per tile cell. The grid is indexed as [col][row] where (0, 0) is the top-left corner.

Map file format

/map/map1.txt contains 60 rows × 80 space-separated integers. Each integer is an index into tiles.

  • Field Details

    • tiles

      public Tile[] tiles
      Array of tile archetypes. Each element defines the sprite and whether that tile type blocks movement. Currently two types: index 0 = dirt (solid wall), index 1 = grass (walkable).

    • mapTilesNum

      public int[][] mapTilesNum
      Tile-type index grid: mapTilesNum[col][row] holds the index into tiles for that map cell. Dimensions: 80 columns × 60 rows.
